R1_dispatch_mechanism.issue: The dispatch-preflight artifact prose states 'clean cmd /c invocation of canonical venv interpreter', while the operator execution report states cmd /c was blocked by the harness and the native PowerShell call operator `&` with explicit redirection was used instead.
R1_dispatch_mechanism.rationale: The failed Start-Process event itself durably records python_invoked=false, main_entered=false, revision_consumed=false, marker_absent=true, and its timestamp precedes the science start marker. It therefore consumed no science attempt regardless of which corrected wrapper subsequently dispatched the real attempt.

R2_dice_comparison_count_not_statically_.issue: The original forensic artifact listed H_dice_comparisons_808 among statically ruled-out conditions, justified by finiteness of the REFERENCE Dice values.
R2_dice_comparison_count_not_statically_.correction: The frozen gate increments n_dice_comparisons ONLY when the GENERATED Dice (grec['final_dice']) is non-null AND finite (v1.14 line 2484). Reference Dice finiteness does NOT bound the generated-side count.
R2_dice_comparison_count_not_statically_.corrected_classification: H_dice_comparisons_808 is NOT independently ruled out; it is COUPLED to D_missing_generated_dice_zero. If any generated Dice is None/nonfinite, D fails AND H fails simultaneously.
